name: Qdrant Cloud Free
free_limit: One ongoing Free single-node Qdrant Cloud cluster with 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk; no credit card required
watch_out: Free is for prototyping, not production: limited cloud/region choice and no high availability or production SLA. Cluster suspends after one week of inactivity and is DELETED after four weeks unless reactivated; snapshots must be managed manually. Free hosted Qdrant is separate from self-hosted OSS and paid inference.
